title: Large Language Models for Code Generation: A Comprehensive Survey of Challenges, Techniques, Evaluation, and Applications
measurement_description: The paper surveyed existing research that measured the generation of harmful code expressing prejudice against specific religions, where religious groups were associated with derogatory terms.
findings: The paper, citing reference [34], reports that models like Codex and InCoder generated harmful code that associated the religion Islam and its followers (Muslims) with derogatory terms. It also highlighted a trade-off where models with better code generation performance, such as Codex and larger CodeGen models, exhibited more severe biases.
